shared_constraints.result_formula: For each destinationchunk i, sum offsets q[k] times [L64*leftIn64(i,k)+LW*leftIn32(i,k)+R64*rightIn64(i,k)+RW*rightIn32(i,k)+fill64*rightOutside64(i,k)+fill32*rightOutside32(i,k)]. Each In/Outside expression is an affine sum of table output columns chosen by static chunk index bounds. L64/LW/R64/RW are linear selector sums; fill64/fill32 are committed advice constrained to selSRA*sign63/selSRAW*sign31. Therefore every term is q*mode*table or q*fill*table, degree3. Upper W result chunks add wordMode*allOnes*signC31, degree2. Never multiply an additional direction/word selector onto already gated fill advice.
